- public final class Version
  - private final int number;
  - private final String renderedText;
  - public Version(int number, String renderedText)
  - public int getNumber()
  - public String getRenderedText()
  - public boolean equals(Object o)
  - public int hashCode()
  - public String toString()
- Semantics: Value object with value-based equality by number and renderedText. Immutable; constructor stores given values without mutation; getters return stored values; toString returns a stable human-readable representation including both fields.

src/main/java/Template.java:
- public final class Template
  - private final String name;
  - private final String content;
  - public Template(String name, String content)
  - public String getName()
  - public String getContent()
  - public String applyCustomFields(java.util.Map<String, String> fields)
- Semantics: Immutable template with deterministic placeholder substitution. The literal placeholder form is {{key}}. applyCustomFields:
  - Treat null fields map as empty.
  - For each entry in fields, replace all literal occurrences of {{key}} in content with value (null values are treated as empty string "").
  - Missing placeholders remain unchanged. No side effects. Deterministic: same inputs produce same outputs.

src/main/java/Validator.java:
- public final class Validator
  - public static boolean validateHeadline(String text)
  - public static boolean validateBody(String text)
  - public static boolean validateContact(String text)
- Semantics: Stateless validation utilities. validateHeadline/validateBody return true iff text is non-null and contains at least one non-whitespace character (trim().isEmpty() == false). validateContact returns true iff text is non-null, contains exactly one '@', and both the local part (before '@') and domain part (after '@') are non-empty after trimming. All methods return false for invalid inputs and never throw.

src/main/java/PressRelease.java:
- public final class PressRelease
  - private final String id, headline, body, contact;
  - private final Template template;
  - private final java.util.LinkedHashMap<String,String> customFields; (defensive copy)
  - private ReleaseState state; (initially DRAFT)
  - private final java.util.LinkedHashSet<String> tags; (insertion ordered, trimmed, unique)
  - private final java.util.List<Version> versionHistory; (insertion ordered)
  - public PressRelease(String id, String headline, String body, String contact, Template template, java.util.Map<String,String> customFields)
  - public String getId()
  - public String getHeadline()
  - public String getBody()
  - public String getContact()
  - public ReleaseState getState()
  - public boolean validate()
  - public void submitForReview()
  - public void publish()
  - public void addTag(String tag)
  - public java.util.List<String> getTags()
  - public String renderPlainText()
  - public java.util.List<Version> getVersionHistory()
- Semantics:
  - Construction: stores provided values; copies customFields into an insertion-ordered LinkedHashMap (null map treated as empty); initializes state to DRAFT; tags empty; versionHistory empty.
  - validate(): returns Validator.validateHeadline(headline) && Validator.validateBody(body) && Validator.validateContact(contact). No side effects.
  - submitForReview(): Requires current state == DRAFT and validate() == true. On success, state transitions to REVIEW. Otherwise throws IllegalStateException.
  - publish(): Requires current state == REVIEW. On success, appends exactly one new Version(1, renderPlainText()) to versionHistory if this is the first publication (i.e., versionHistory is empty) and sets state to PUBLISHED. Any call when not in REVIEW throws IllegalStateException. No randomness/clock involved.
  - addTag(String tag): Ignores null or blank input. Stores trimmed tag. Maintains insertion order and uniqueness (no duplicate entries). No exception for duplicates; duplicates are ignored.
  - getTags(): Returns a defensive copy (java.util.ArrayList) of tags preserving insertion order.
  - renderPlainText(): Builds a new field map with keys "headline", "body", "contact" using the instance fields, then overlays/extends with constructor customFields (constructor fields take effect in addition to the three built-ins; if the map contains these keys, their values will be used by Template substitution rules). Delegates to template.applyCustomFields(map) and returns result. No mutation of internal collections.
  - getVersionHistory(): Returns a defensive copy (java.util.ArrayList) of versions preserving insertion order.
  - Error behavior: submitForReview()/publish() throw IllegalStateException on invalid transitions; other methods avoid throwing for invalid data, except standard NPE if required constructor arguments (like template) are null and dereferenced later by caller; tests rely only on specified behavior.

src/main/java/TaggingSystem.java:
- public final class TaggingSystem
  - public static java.util.List<PressRelease> searchByTag(java.util.List<PressRelease> releases, String tag)
- Semantics: Returns a new list preserving the input order of releases that contain the exact trimmed tag in their getTags() collection. If releases is null or tag is null, returns an empty list. The tag argument is trimmed before matching; matching is exact (case-sensitive). Stateless and deterministic.
